'''Coyotepec Popoloca''' is an indigenous language of the [[Mexican state]] of [[Puebla]]. It is spoken in the municipality of [[Coyotepec, Puebla|Coyotepec]]. The dialect of the town of San Mateo is counted as Coyotepec, but it may be a distinct language, or a dialect of [[Western Popoloca language|San Felipe Otlaltepec]] (Western Popoloca). Coyotepec proper and Western Popoloca are about 40% [[mutually intelligible]].
